notes.title: Fly between more areas
notes.body:
- Experimental Soaring flight now reaches more connected outdoor routes and towns.
- Followers keep a little more room behind you, and their walking steps stay in time around corners.
- Mega battle animations play the supplied artwork frame by frame.

Try Soaring from Settings → Experimental features → Soaring flight, then Unova → Pokémon → Take flight. Please check that you can cross between areas and land in the right place. To test Mega Salamence, give it Salamencite and press L + R while choosing a move in battle.

notes.title: Smoother followers and Mega animations
notes.body:
- Pokémon followers stay about one tile behind and move smoothly around corners.
- Launcher menus now have navigation, confirm, and cancel sounds. Change the volume or turn them off in Settings.
- Mega Pokémon with supplied animated artwork play the full animation during battle. Mega Salamence has 67 frames on each side.

Please test Mega Salamence in battle: give it Salamencite and press L + R together while choosing a move. Check whether it animates and stays correctly positioned.

notes.title: Mega Pokémon animations
notes.body:
- Mega Pokémon with supplied animated artwork now play through their GIF frames during battle.
- Mega Salamence is the first animation test, with 67 frames.
- Give it Salamencite and press L + R together while choosing a move.

notes.title: Updated Mega Mewtwo X artwork
notes.body: - Mega Mewtwo X now uses updated battle artwork.

notes.title: A bigger Mega roster
notes.body:
- The game now supports 49 Mega forms, with matching Mega Stones.
- Buy Mega Stones at Pokémon Center Marts for ₽50,000 each. Give a Pokémon its matching stone, then hold L + R while choosing a move.
- Mega Evolution lasts until the battle ends.

notes.title: More Mega Pokémon
notes.body:
- Mega forms arrive for Ampharos, Venusaur, Charizard Y, Gengar, Alakazam, Mawile, and Garchomp.
- Matching Mega Stones are sold at Pokémon Center Marts for ₽50,000 each.
- Hold L + R while choosing a move in battle to Mega Evolve.

notes.title: 12 more Mega Pokémon
notes.body:
- Mega forms arrive for Serperior, Arcanine, Aggron, Altaria, Banette, Gallade, Heracross, Latios, Manectric, Sableye, Salamence, and Scizor.
- Give a Pokémon its matching Mega Stone and hold L + R while choosing a move in battle.

notes.title: Mega Serperior ready for the next battle
notes.body:
- Improved Mega Serperior's appearance during battle.
- Mega Evolution is ready to use again after a battle ends.

notes.title: Open your party after Mega Evolution
notes.body:
- Fixed a crash that could happen when opening the Pokémon menu after Mega Evolving Serperior.
- Serperior stays Mega Evolved during battle. The party screen shows its regular icon.

notes.title: Mega Serperior gains Adaptability
notes.body:
- Mega Serperior now has the Adaptability ability instead of Contrary while Mega Evolved.
- Give it Serperiorite and hold L + R while choosing a move in battle.

notes.title: Mega Serperior battle fix
notes.body:
- Fixed a problem that could occur after choosing a move while Mega Evolving Serperior.
- Mega Serperior now keeps its form and stats through the battle, then returns to normal when the battle ends.
- Give Serperior Serperiorite and hold L + R while choosing a move to try it.

notes.title: Fix for a Windows startup problem
notes.body:
- Fixed a Windows issue that could stop the game from opening.
- Close the emulator before updating, then start it again from the launcher.

notes.title: Mega Serperior preview update
notes.body:
- Continue trying Mega Serperior in battle with Serperiorite.
- Choose Fight, then hold L + R while selecting a move. Save your game before trying this preview.

notes.title: Mega Serperior in battle
notes.body:
- Mega Serperior and Serperiorite are available in supported Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 games.
- Hold L + R while choosing a move to Mega Evolve. The Multiplayer Debug menu can grant the stone.

notes.title: Mega Serperior preview
notes.body:
- Continue trying Mega Serperior's battle form and stats in this preview.
- Give it Serperiorite, then hold L + R while choosing a move. Save your game before trying new features.

notes.title: Mega Serperior arrives
notes.body:
- Mega Evolve Serperior in supported English Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 games.
- Give Serperior Serperiorite, choose Fight, then hold L + R while selecting a move.
- If you need the stone for this preview, use Multiplayer → Debug to grant it.

notes.title: Smoother LAN hosting
notes.body: - Hosting a local game is smoother when several network events happen at once.

notes.title: Safer game updates
notes.body:
- Updates install alongside your current game, so you can finish a session before switching versions.
- The launcher only checks for a running game from your Unova Together installation.
- Your ROM, saves, and settings stay in place.

notes.title: Better Soaring landings
notes.body:
- See more of the ground while flying and return to a landing area more smoothly.
- Confirm before returning to take-off, and enjoy steadier flight while using speedup.

notes.title: A wider view while soaring
notes.body:
- Soaring shows more of the surrounding scenery.
- Turn it on under Settings → Experimental features, then choose Unova → Pokémon → Take flight.
- Soaring is an optional preview.

notes.title: Smoother Pokémon followers
notes.body:
- Follower movement is smoother, and followers stay visible through brief connection hiccups.
- Followers update correctly when your party or area changes.
- Shiny followers use the odds from your loaded game.

notes.title: Repair older launcher shortcuts
notes.body:
- If an old shortcut keeps opening an outdated launcher, run Repair-Launcher.exe once and choose the Pokémon Together.exe that shortcut used.
- Your ROMs, profiles, saves, and backups stay in place.

notes.title: Smoother launcher updates
notes.body:
- After an update, the launcher opens the newly installed game.
- Older shortcuts can now open the latest launcher without changing your saves or settings.

notes.title: Trainer search and a flight shortcut
notes.body:
- Find practice trainers by name or class before starting a no-reward battle.
- An optional Fly shortcut opens the game's usual party menu and destinations.

notes.title: Spend time with your companion
notes.body:
- Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon. Its reactions reflect its nature and friendship.
- Face your follower and hold R while pressing A, or tap the follower, to open the interaction menu.

notes.title: Balanced solo experience
notes.body: - The extra experience earned in solo battles has been adjusted for a more balanced pace.

notes.title: Free up storage safely
notes.body:
- Remove unused old game copies from the launcher to free up space.
- Your active game, saves, backups, ROMs, and custom files are kept safe.

notes.title: Manage saves with ease
notes.body:
- Create separate game slots so each one keeps its own save.
- Back up or restore saves from one place.
- Use the experience calculator to plan solo battles.

notes.title: A boost for solo battles
notes.body: - Solo battles now award extra experience to help you progress while playing alone.

notes.title: More reliable co-op
notes.body:
- Reconnecting and recovering a co-op session is more reliable.
- The launcher gives clearer connection messages and retry options.

notes.title: Unova Together is here
notes.body:
- Explore with friends, see nearby teammates, trade items or Pokémon, and battle together.
- Enjoy Pokémon followers, companion interactions, co-op trainer battles, Pokémon tools, and optional battle scenery.
- The launcher includes profiles, local hosting, save backups, updates, and installation repair.

notes.title: Companion interactions and flight
notes.body:
- Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon.
- Try an experimental flight preview over the area around you.
- These interactions are cosmetic and do not change your save.

notes.title: Quicker menus and reconnects
notes.body:
- Move between the Players, Pokémon, Co-op, and Settings pages from the tabs or with L/R.
- The Options shortcut and reconnects work more reliably.
- Follower controls and trainer battle settings are easier to find.

notes.title: Easier co-op tools
notes.body:
- Pokémon tools, co-op settings, and game options are easier to find.
- Choose solo or co-op trainer battles, try no-reward practice rematches, or challenge another player.
- Show or hide followers and see clearer teammate status.

notes.title: More Pokémon tools
notes.body:
- Browse nearby encounters by season and relearn level-up moves for free.
- Use field moves without taking up one of a Pokémon's four battle move slots.

notes.title: Followers and party stats
notes.body:
- Followers are now available for all 649 Pokémon, with a gentle idle animation.
- View your Pokémon's IVs and EVs from the launcher.

notes.title: Battle scenery and better followers
notes.body:
- Try optional 3D battle scenery created from your own game copy.
- Pokémon followers have improved sprites and animations.
- The in-game Options shortcut now opens the right menu.

notes.title: Bigger LAN sessions
notes.body:
- Host local sessions with up to 16 players, and let guests join after the host starts.
- Co-op invitations and reconnects are more reliable.
- Traded Pokémon follow the game's obedience rules in supported Black 2 versions.

notes.title: More reliable player tracking
notes.body:
- The player list better reflects which area your teammates are visiting.
- Teammate locations and battle status recover more reliably after menus and battles.
- Teammates can stay visible behind in-game menus when the game view allows it.

notes.title: Clearer teammate locations
notes.body:
- See your teammates' locations and battle status more reliably.
- The player list gives a clearer message when a teammate's location is unavailable.

notes.title: Easy setup and co-op
notes.body:
- Set up or update your game, host or join a local session, and reconnect from the launcher.
- Find setup guides, optional music, and keyboard or controller controls in one place.
- Your game files and saves stay on your computer when you update.
